en.cli.agent_owned: This LaunchAgent belongs to another runtime; uninstall that integration first
en.cli.description: Local live progress for Codex Desktop
en.cli.desktop: Requested Codex to open. An existing instance must quit normally and reopen to use the new backend entry point.
en.cli.desktop_isolated: Requested an isolated Codex test instance with the specified profile. Keep the main app open and submit a test chat in the new window.
en.cli.gui_managed: This integration is managed by the GUI. Configure or restore it in the app; terminal watch / status remain available.
en.cli.installed: Launch at login and the default Desktop capture entry point are installed. Current tasks continue; integration starts after you quit and reopen Codex.
en.cli.language: UI language; uses the saved preference or Chinese by default
en.cli.launch_agent: Set up launch at login and the default Desktop entry point
en.cli.original_invalid: Original Codex CLI is not executable: {path}
en.cli.original_wrapper: The original CLI cannot point to the wrapper
en.cli.runtime_long: Runtime path is too long for a macOS Unix socket; choose a shorter path with --runtime
en.cli.thread: Filter by chat name or ID
en.cli.uninstalled: Original launch environment restored. Reopening Codex will use the original CLI; current tasks can finish.
en.control.agent_changed: The previous launch item has changed; it was not overwritten.
en.control.agent_rollback_failed: The previous launch item has not been restored; its backup is retained.
en.control.agent_unload_failed: Cannot disable the previous Monitor restart service.
en.control.another_gui_running: Another Monitor UI is collecting activity. Quit that instance first.
en.control.another_gui_running.2: Collection is managed by another Monitor UI; it was not stopped.
en.control.app_missing: Monitor App was not found. Build or download it again.
en.control.app_missing.2: Configuration requires the Monitor App path.
en.control.backup_missing: A previous wrapper was found without its original backup; current configuration was not overwritten.
en.control.backup_missing.2: The original configuration backup is missing; restoration and deletion were stopped.
en.control.cleanup_pending: Finish the previous restoration and cleanup before configuring again.
en.control.entry_missing: The executable original CLI or local Python was not found.
en.control.environment_write_failed: Cannot restore or set launch setting: {value}
en.control.foreign_agent: The existing launch item belongs to another Monitor; it was left unchanged.
en.control.foreign_data_root: The data directory contains unregistered content; ownership was not assumed.
en.control.foreign_data_root.2: Cannot verify ownership of the data directory.
en.control.gui_upgrade_required: Monitor and its backend are incompatible. Update and reopen Monitor.
en.control.legacy_ambiguous: The previous backup cannot distinguish empty from unset values. Confirm the original state before migrating.
en.control.legacy_invalid: The previous integration backup is incomplete; configuration was left unchanged.
en.control.legacy_invalid.2: The previous integration values have an invalid format; configuration was left unchanged.
en.control.login_cleanup_failed: Launch at login could not be removed; the restoration record is retained.
en.control.login_cleanup_unavailable: Use a newly downloaded app to finish removing the login item.
en.control.management_busy: Another management operation is still running. Try again shortly.
en.control.owner_missing: The Monitor UI process was not found.
en.control.owner_missing.2: The UI process identity is missing.
en.control.record_version: The management record version is unsupported; it was not overwritten.
en.control.recursive_cli: The original CLI cannot point to the Monitor wrapper.
en.control.runtime_long: The runtime path is too long to create the local communication endpoint.
en.control.source_missing: The local backend entry point was not found.
en.control.state_unavailable: Live state is temporarily unavailable. Try again; an owned collector will not be started twice.
en.control.stop_timeout: The collector has not stopped. Try again; Codex was not terminated.
en.control.stop_timeout.2: The collector is still exiting. The restoration record is retained; try again shortly.
en.control.unowned_data: The data directory contains unregistered files; full cleanup was not performed.
en.control.unowned_data.2: The timeline directory contains unregistered files; full cleanup was not performed.
en.control.unowned_data.3: The runtime directory contains remaining or unregistered files; it was not deleted.
en.control.unowned_data.4: The runtime directory still contains bridge records; it was not deleted.
en.control.unsafe_data_root: The app data directory cannot be a system, home, or source root.
en.detail.image_notice: This input contains images. See the preview below.
en.detail.missing_input: The source record provides no separate input.
en.detail.missing_output: The source has no result for this call yet.
en.speed.partial: Some current generation rates are unavailable
en.view.footer: j/k or ↑/↓ Select · Enter Expand activities{language_hint} · q Quit | Output includes Reasoning · Usage updates in batches · ≈ Estimated · — No reliable data
en.view.settings_failed: Language changed, but the preference could not be saved.
